profile: weight vector decomposition over feature matrix: In an M-dimensional space, any vector ω can be decomposed over the column space of a given feature matrix F as ω = Fz + r. The term Fz lies in the column space of F, while r is a residual vector. This decomposition splits a weight vector into a part spanned by the feature matrix columns and a remaining part.
